findings.title: ECDSAAlgorithmTest uses a 256-bit key for ES384/ES512 and never verifies the DER signature
findings.body: `ECDSAAlgorithmTest` initializes a single default `KeyPairGenerator.getInstance("EC")` key pair (256-bit `secp256r1`) and reuses it across `testES256`, `testES384`, and `testES512`. Because ECDSA `r` and `s` values are bounded by the curve order, signing with a 256-bit key always produces `r` and `s` of at most 32 bytes (~70-byte DER signature) even with `SHA384withECDSA` and `SHA512withECDSA`. As a result, `testES384` and `testES512` never test 48-byte (`secp384r1`) or 66-byte (`secp521r1`) components, and never exercise the multi-byte ASN.1 length encoding/decoding (`length > 127`) in `ASN1Encoder.writeLength` and `ASN1Decoder.readLength` that real ES512 signatures (~138 bytes) require. Additionally, `test()` only checks the round-trip back to `rsConcat2` with its own decoder and never checks `signature.verify(asn1Des)` with the JCA `Signature` verifier.

findings.title: Indefinite length (0x80) returns -1 in readLength() and causes NegativeArraySizeException or stream corruption
findings.body: `readLength()` returns `-1` when it encounters `0x80` (indefinite-length encoding), but none of its callers handle `-1`. In `readInteger()`, `length = -1` is passed directly to `read(length)`, throwing an unchecked `NegativeArraySizeException` at `new byte[length]` instead of an `IOException`. In `readNext()`, `length += reset()` adds the header byte count to `-1`, reading a truncated byte array and corrupting subsequent reads in `readSequence()`. Because DER forbids indefinite-length encodings, `readLength()` should throw an `IOException` when `length == 0x80`.

findings.title: Redundant ASN1Encoder.create().write(...) calls in concatenatedRSToASN1DER
findings.body: Lines 114-115 call `ASN1Encoder.create().write(rBigInteger)` and `ASN1Encoder.create().write(sBigInteger)` and discard the returned encoders immediately before lines 119-120 perform the exact same encoding inside `writeDerSeq(...)`. Lines 114-115 should be removed.
